page.content:
FIFA president who made the first World Cup happen.

How Jules Rimet connects

  • Topic: FIFA World Cup — Jules Rimet drove FIFA to stage the first World Cup in 1930.
  • Faction: FIFA — Jules Rimet was the FIFA president who made the World Cup real.
  • Item: Jules Rimet Trophy — The original World Cup trophy was named for Jules Rimet.

What is Jules Rimet?

Jules Rimet was the FIFA president who drove the 1930 tournament in Uruguay. The original trophy later bore his name until Brazil kept it after a third win.

Key threads lead to FIFA World Cup, FIFA and Jules Rimet Trophy.
